Summary.en: Injects custom CSS into the page, with optional placeholder and dark-mode replacements.
Summary.de: Fügt benutzerdefiniertes CSS in die Seite ein, mit optionalen Platzhalter- und Darkmode-Ersetzungen.
Summary.it: Inietta CSS personalizzato nella pagina, con sostituzioni opzionali di segnaposto e dark mode.

Parameter.Replacements: An array of two-element strings separated by '|'. The first part is the placeholder found in the CSS, the second the string it shall be replaced with.
Parameter.Darkmode: The Darkmode replacements that replace all placeholders ending with '_DM' in the provided CSS.
Parameter.Destination: The selector pointing to the CSS destination.

Replacements.default: An array of two-element strings separated by '|'. The first part is the placeholder found in the CSS, the second the string it shall be replaced with.

Darkmode.default: The Darkmode replacements that replace all placeholders ending with '_DM' in the provided CSS.

Destination.default: The selector pointing to the CSS destination.
